## Overview

This document describes the patient cohort using static baseline characteristics and per-patient follow-up counts.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(table1)
library(tidyverse)
library(tinytable)

source(here("R", "io.R"))
source(here("R", "table_rendering.R"))

ensure_dir(here("output", "01_cohort"))
```


```{r}
#| label: load-data
patients <- read_parquet(here("output", "derived", "patients_baseline.parquet")) |>
  mutate(
    ecog_baseline = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(factor(ecog_baseline), level = "Missing"),
    diagnosis_group = forcats::fct_recode(
      factor(diagnosis_group),
      "Lung" = "LUNG",
      "Lymphoid malignancy" = "LYMPH",
      "Skin" = "SKIN",
      "Prostate" = "PROSTATE",
      "Gastrointestinal" = "BOWEL"
    ),
    diagnosis_group = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(
      diagnosis_group,
      level = "Missing"
    ),
    treatment_plan_group = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(factor(treatment_plan_group), level = "Missing")
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: build-table1
table1_data <- patients |>
  mutate(
    Age = age,
    Sex = sex,
    Language = language,
    `Marital status` = marital_status,
    ECOG = ecog_baseline,
    `Primary cancer site` = diagnosis_group,
    `Treatment plan` = treatment_plan_group,
    `Had reminder` = reminder,
    `Reminder group` = factor(
      reminder,
      levels = c("No", "Yes"),
      labels = c("No reminder", "Reminder")
    ),
    `Questionnaires per patient` = n_questionnaires,
    `Appointment days per patient` = n_appointments
  ) |>
  select(
    Age,
    Sex,
    Language,
    `Marital status`,
    ECOG,
    `Primary cancer site`,
    `Treatment plan`,
    `Had reminder`,
    `Reminder group`,
    `Questionnaires per patient`,
    `Appointment days per patient`
  )

cohort_main_table1 <- table1(
  ~ Age + Sex + Language + `Marital status` + ECOG + `Primary cancer site` +
    `Treatment plan` +
    `Had reminder` + `Questionnaires per patient` +
    `Appointment days per patient`,
  data = table1_data,
  caption = "Baseline characteristics of the cohort.",
  render.continuous = c(. = "Median [Min, Max]")
)

cohort_by_reminder_table1 <- table1(
  ~ Age + Sex + Language + `Marital status` + ECOG + `Primary cancer site` +
    `Treatment plan` +
    `Questionnaires per patient` + `Appointment days per patient` | `Reminder group`,
  data = table1_data,
  caption = "Baseline characteristics by reminder status.",
  render.continuous = c(. = "Median [Min, Max]"),
  overall = FALSE
)

# Save table1 objects for use in report
saveRDS(cohort_main_table1, here("output", "01_cohort", "cohort_main_table1.rds"))
saveRDS(cohort_by_reminder_table1, here("output", "01_cohort", "cohort_by_reminder_table1.rds"))
```
